notes: Free Cam for videos: the host turns on "Free Cam" in the lobby, then F9 flies a free camera (WASD, Space up, C down, Shift faster). Map lists end with Random Map: the host's game picks one of the maps and everyone sees the pick. Cleaner skin selection: short names, Spy Male and Upsilon Force with Normal, Hardcore and Pro, Spy Female with Normal, Hardcore, Pro, Lara, Viper and Enrica, Sam Fisher A to E, merc colours Urban / Night / Original / Desert. A merc's scoped headshot kill of a spy shows a crimson headshot icon in the chat and plays a sound for the killer and the victim. Team pings now play a sound for your teammates from the direction of the ping, with its own Ping Volume slider under Options > Audio. Hosts send network updates on a fixed budget at any frame rate and hold the network speed up while players are connected, to fix the lag of high-frame-rate hosts (the host can switch it off for the match with the lobby row "Host Net Fix: On / Off"; if players stutter, send your log bundle from the launcher). Controllers: Controls > Sensitivity has a new Controller Style switch; Legacy keeps today's stick feel, Modern unlocks deadzone, outer deadzone, response curve, slow zone and smoothing settings (merc aiming). Lifts no longer trap a player inside the platform or bounce up and down endlessly (Club House, Orphanage, Factory). Orphanage: the dormitory vent duct can now be climbed into from both ends, and the merc drone, ammo box and vent covers there were fixed. Crash fixes: closing the game window no longer crashes it, a host restarting the map after a long session, the empty sixth group of the Challenge menu (removed), a rare sound crash in long sessions, and the game can now use up to 4 GB of memory on 64-bit Windows (fewer out-of-memory crashes). Every player in a match needs this version.
